description: Answer one short question about one company from its own filed values: statements, ratios, guidance, company metrics, segments and recent 8-K events. The answer in data.answer is written by an AI model and is labelled as such in data.label. The model sees only a numbered list of our facts. The server then checks that every number in the answer matches a fact it cites, and withholds the answer when one does not: data.answer is null, data.withheld_reason says why, and data.related_facts lists the facts to read instead. data.citations holds each cited fact as a value object with its proof and filing link, so quote those values, not the prose. It restates filed values; it does not compute, forecast or advise, and an answer with words of advice is withheld. It needs an API key or a signed-in connector: without one the answer is unauthorized with a sign-in link. Each key or connector has 20 answers a day (data.usage); a withheld answer does not count. Use it for a quick factual question such as last year's revenue or margin; use the statement, ratio or line item tools when you need the full table or an exact line.

examples.question: What was revenue and gross margin last fiscal year?

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

company.description: Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

question.description: The question about this company. Plain English, 3 to 300 characters, no links. Example: What was revenue and gross margin last fiscal year?

name: ask_company

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { question, answer (string or null), citations: [{ fact, dataset, label, period, value (value object with proof) or null, text, source_url }], withheld_reason (null, no_facts, cannot_answer, no_citations, unknown_citation, unverified_numbers, invalid_model_output, advice, prompt_attack, harmful_content), unverified_numbers: [string], related_facts: [same shape as citations], facts_considered, generated_by "model", label, model, method_version, disclaimer, cached }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: AI-written answer about one company
